One Browser Tab, Multiple Live Streams

A multistream viewer removes the friction of opening and managing a stack of tabs during live events. TooManyStreams keeps multiple Twitch and YouTube streams in one place so you can follow the creators, casters, and side angles that matter most.

Organize Your Stream Wall Your Way

Different events demand different layouts. TooManyStreams lets you build a custom stream wall, rearrange streams as the action shifts, and keep your favorite creators on screen without constantly resizing browser windows.

Better For Esports, Watch Parties, and Creator Events

Whether you are tracking an esports bracket, watching a creator tournament, or following multiple live perspectives at once, TooManyStreams gives you a cleaner way to stay locked in on the full event without missing context.
